notes: **Raised tabs are now exactly as thick as your "preferred raised tab thickness".** A raised tab that is all ramp with no flat section on top — which is how the tabs come out with the designer's standard settings, and always the case with a ramp angle of 0 — used to come out 1 mm thicker than the setting. The designer would also quietly make a tab thinner than you asked if it would have stood more than 1 mm above the top of the keyguard. Now every tab is built at the thickness you enter, however thick that is. If you made a keyguard with ramped raised tabs before this version and want the same tab when you print it again, add 1 mm to its preferred raised tab thickness (from 2 to 3, for example). The ready-to-print designs have been changed to 3 mm, so they print exactly as before. A tab with embedded magnets is still made thick enough to hold them.

"Show split line" no longer tells you to set it to "no" before rendering your design. The split line only ever appears on screen while you design; it is never part of a rendered keyguard or a file you export, so you can leave it on.
